messages:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-service-eu — high 5xx rate (alert PD-4682). Details: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD-4682

maria (oncall): acked and taking — jumping into runbook now :hand:

pagerduty-bot: Alert acknowledged by maria (oncall)

josh: I'm around if you need help. Any customer impact yet?

maria (oncall): quick glance at dashboards: 5xx rate spiked to ~4.8% (baseline ~0.1%). Errors mostly 502/504. P95 latency up to 3.4s. Region: eu-west-1. I pinged support and put a short note on status.redwood.com.

kevin: logs look like upstream grpc deadlines to a subset of model hosts + lots of KV cache misses causing cold starts. snippet from the logs:

```
2026-03-14T09:12:03Z model-host-12 grpc: deadline exceeded
2026-03-14T09:12:04Z model-host-14 kv_cache: miss, load_time=780ms
2026-03-14T09:12:05Z model-host-14 grpc: connection reset by peer
```

josh: looks like autoscaler didn't react quickly enough. maria, can you try scaling the inference pool in eu-west-1? `redwoodctl pool scale --region eu-west-1 --pool inference-eu --delta 3`

maria (oncall): running the scale command now, will update when nodes start provisioning

opsbot: Running: `redwoodctl pool scale --region eu-west-1 --pool inference-eu --delta 3` — accepted. Provisioning 3 nodes (est ~2m).

maria (oncall): done, scale started. also applying temporary routing fallback to quantized variant for burst traffic: `route-policy apply --name eu-burst-fallback --fallback model-inference-eu-quant2`

josh: good call. can we also isolate model-host-14? seeing OOM-ish traces there.

kevin: evicting host now to let it drain: `redwoodctl host evict model-host-14 --region eu-west-1` — evict command returned SUCCESS.

sre-runbook: FYI — please add mitigation notes & customer impact to the incident ticket. Also run evals against the quantized fallback for top tenants after traffic stabilizes.

maria (oncall): customer impact estimate: roughly 2.3% of live requests returned errors between 09:10-09:20 UTC. Affected tenants (by volume): acme-corp, beta-inc. Support notified and initial status posted.

josh: after scale + eviction + fallback, error rate down to ~0.4% and p95 back to ~400ms. continuing 10m watch. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-4682 status: acknowledged. Responder: maria (oncall).

maria (oncall): I'll own this for a 30m watch window and then handoff. If anything regresses, please @maria (oncall) directly.

kevin: action item for postmortem: investigate KV cache cold-starts and autoscaler threshold tuning. I'll pick this up after the watch.

maria (oncall): thanks everyone — removing temporary routing and leaving the scaled capacity for an hour.

opsbot: Executed: `route-policy revert --name eu-burst-fallback` — success.

maria (oncall): final update: metrics stable for 20m, error rate returned to baseline. closing this thread — will file follow-up ticket for root-cause analysis. Thanks all :pray:
